title: Run the Dang Ball!
text: This is a story about running the ball. We are seeing if running the ball is needed to win games.

title: Run the Dang Ball!
text:
Chart 1: Rushing yards vs. wins


Code
ggplot(chart1, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick", formula = y ~ x) +
  geom_point(data = label1, color = "navy", size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label1, aes(label = team),
                  size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", box.padding = 0.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  annotate("text", x = max(chart1$rush_ypg), y = 0.5, hjust = 1,
           fontface = "bold", label = paste0("Correlation (r) = ", round(r, 2))) +
  labs(title = "Rushing Yards per Game vs. Wins (2025 FBS Season)",
       x = "Rushing Yards per Game",
       y = "Wins")

title: Run the Dang Ball!
text:
Chart 2: Elite vs. losing teams


Code
ggplot(chart2, aes(x = record_group, y = avg_rush_ypg, fill = record_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(avg_rush_ypg, 1), " yds/game\n(", teams, " teams)")),
            vjust = -0.4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Elite (10+ wins)" = "forestgreen",
                               "Losing record"    = "firebrick")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(title = "Average Rushing Yards per Game: Elite vs. Losing Teams (2025 FBS)",
       x = "Team Record Group",
       y = "Average Rushing Yards per Game")

title: Run the Dang Ball!
section: Chart 3: Rushing offense vs. defense (bubble chart)
text:
Chart 3: Rushing offense vs. defense (bubble chart)


Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = chart3,
             aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg, size = wins, fill = record_group),
             shape = 21, color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label3,
                  aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg, label = team),
                  size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", box.padding = 0.6,
                  min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 10), breaks = c(4, 8, 12, 16),
                        name = "Total Wins") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Record",
                    values = c("Elite (10+ wins)" = "forestgreen",
                               "Middle"           = "gray65",
                               "Losing record"    = "firebrick")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  labs(title = "Rushing Offense vs. Defense, Sized by Total Wins (2025 FBS Season)",
       x = "Rushing Yards per Game",
       y = def_label)
